mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) combined with a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals weakening demand and labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases and UNRATE increases concurrently
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and UNRATE increases concurrently and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% signals a restrictive policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% during a tightening cycle and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.
